scoring_justification: Cannot recompute critical doses from raw MD trajectories because agent only submits final values; elastic constant curves and huge trajectory files are not in the output contract. Result-level comparison against paper-reported gold with tolerances is the necessary compromise.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for amorphization outcomes, critical doses (dpa), and shear modulus ratio from the paper Cu-Ti intermetallic MD study.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 2, Section 3.1, and the description of Fig. 2 for Cu4Ti: critical doses for Cu4Ti3 (0.6 dpa), CuTi (1.0 dpa), CuTi2 (0.45 dpa), Cu4Ti grouped (4.17 dpa); Cu4Ti not amorphized under single Frenkel pairs; Cu4Ti amorphized under grouped Frenkel pairs; shear modulus ratio C_avg_d/C_avg_c ≈ 0.5.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted directly from the paper's reported text and figures. Booleans reflect the stated findings. The ratio 0.5 is the factor-of-two drop noted in the conclusions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is a paper reproduction task; the hidden gold must be the paper's actual reported results so that an honest reimplementation of the protocol can hit them within tolerances.

Cu4Ti_single_FP_amorphized.description: whether Cu4Ti becomes amorphous under single Frenkel pair introduction

Cu4Ti_grouped_FP_amorphized.description: whether Cu4Ti becomes amorphous under grouped Frenkel pair introduction

Cu4Ti3_critical_dose.description: critical dose for amorphization of Cu4Ti3 under single Frenkel pairs, in dpa

CuTi_critical_dose.description: critical dose for amorphization of CuTi under single Frenkel pairs, in dpa

CuTi2_critical_dose.description: critical dose for amorphization of CuTi2 under single Frenkel pairs, in dpa

Cu4Ti_grouped_critical_dose.description: critical dose for amorphization of Cu4Ti under grouped Frenkel pairs, in dpa

C_avg_ratio_at_amorphization.description: ratio of average shear modulus at amorphization to that of the perfect crystal

outputs.description: Scored JSON file containing the amorphization outcomes, critical doses, and shear modulus reduction factor.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the reported boolean flags, critical doses, and ratio to paper-derived gold values with tolerances: ±20% relative on critical doses, exact match for boolean outcomes, and ratio within 0.5 ± 0.1.
